Title: 2025-12-16 Live Patch
Subtitle: === Battlegrounds: Alterac Pass ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Battlegrounds: Alterac Pass ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing the Objective capture time to not be capped at 55 seconds.

=== Battlegrounds: Blackheart's Bay ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Bombardment
    • Damage increased from 2815 to 2875.

=== Battlegrounds: Sky Temple ===
[Updates]
  Structures:
  • Forts
    • [Undocumented] The middle-left Fort has been slightly moved towards the top-left of the battlefield.

=== Battlegrounds: Volskaya Foundry ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Triglav Protector
    • Stats
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 6-10 increased from 825 to 862.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 11-15 increased from 1150 to 1294.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 16-20 increased from 1437 to 1725.
      • [Undocumented] Health scaling for minutes 21-60 increased from 1725 to 2156.

=== Battlegrounds: Warhead Junction ===
[Updates]
  Objective:
  • Warheads
    • [Undocumented] Heroic Basic Attacks against Structures recently hit by Warheads no longer set the burning's duration to 5 seconds.
    • Heroic Basic Attacks against Structures recently hit by Warheads now pause the burning's duration for 3 seconds.

=== Heroes: Falstad ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Lightning Rod [W]
    • Now strikes more frequently, from every second to every .8 seconds. Total number of strikes stay the same.
    • Cast range increased from 6.5 to 7.5.
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Frequent Flyer
      • Cooldown increased from 45 to 60 seconds.
      • Quest requirements increased from 50/125/300 to 60/150/300.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Falstad's Gathering Storm to give its second Reward multiple times.

=== Heroes: Gul'dan ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Echoed Corruption
      • Pinnacle Reward healing increased from 50% to 100%.
      • Pinnacle Reward requirement reduced from 100 to 85.
  • Level 16
    • Ruinous Affliction
      • Damage reduced by 10%.

=== Heroes: Kerrigan ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Ravage [Q]
    • Stacks per Hero kill increased from 5 to 7.
    • Baseline Quest requirements increased from 75/125 to 85/150.
  Talents:
  • Level 7
    • Bladed Momentum
      • Cooldown reduction increased from .6 to .75 seconds.

=== Heroes: Sylvanas ===
[Updates]
  Base:
  • Possession [1]
    • Cooldown between uses reduced from 2 to 1 second.
  Talents:
  • Level 4
    • Unstable Poison
      • Damage increased from 130 to 150.
  • Level 4
    • Haunting Arrows
      • No longer affects Mercenaries.

=== Heroes: Thrall ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 1
    • Maelstrom Weapon
      • Quest requirements increased from 20/40/100 to 25/55/100.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Thrall's Tempest Fury to not take into account Maelstrom Weapon's bonus Attack Damage.
